inspection.scope: Initial scalar definition, Type-I/II Yukawa restrictions/Table 1; targeted section 5.9 colour and Appendix E gauge/generation checks. Not all 180 pages read.

claims.locator: atlas/FIELD_CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md, explicit F_SM/R_SM/R_MSSM templates; source model-definition locator below
claims.value: Expand the expressly inherited SM/MSSM with its standard three families and exact representations. Dynkin maps: su(3) 3=[1,0], anti-3=[0,1], adjoint=[1,1]; su(2) d has label [d-1]. All Weyl fields are LH, including u^c,d^c,e^c. Ordinary textbook Y is used only as the declared baseline coordinate, not claimed to be individually tabulated by this source. No right-handed neutrino or additional sector is invented.

claims.locator: Initial scalar-sector definition, PDF/printed p.6 Eqs.(2)-(4)
claims.value: Two complex scalar SU(2) doublets Phi_1,Phi_2 with source hypercharge +1. These replace the one-doublet SM scalar sector; do not add two more to R_SM.

claims.locator: Section 5.9, PDF/printed p.98 opening discussion, combined with two-doublet definition p.6
claims.value: Source explicitly rules out colour breaking in this two-doublet scalar inventory, supporting colour-singlet Higgs doublets; no colour-octet interpretation is introduced.

claims.locator: Appendix E, PDF/printed p.151, opening paragraph and Eqs.(401)-(405)
claims.value: Source explicitly identifies SU(3)_colour, SU(2), U(1), and then specializes the 2HDM to three fermion families. No new fermion inventory is introduced in Type-I/II.

claims.locator: PDF/printed p.6 Eq.(2); Appendix E PDF/printed p.151 opening normalization paragraph
claims.value: Early source label Y_source(H)=+1, while Appendix E says its coupling uses Higgs U(1) charge +1/2. In the early coordinate q=3 Y_source=6 Y_textbook; all fermions are expanded consistently in the same doubled-source coordinate. Do not mix the two source coordinate descriptions.

claims.locator: Section 2 opening Yukawa discussion, PDF/printed pp.9-11, Table 1 p.11
claims.value: Type I: all RH quarks/leptons couple to Phi_2. Type II: up to Phi_2, down and charged leptons to Phi_1, with stated Z2 implementations. Same local algebra/matter, so one candidate linked to both variants. No independent rows for physical mass eigenstates or eaten Goldstones.

duplicate_check.action: Link the paper to the existing entry; do not create a second field-content entry.
duplicate_check.limits: Field-content identity only, not physical-theory equivalence. General U(1) basis mixing, simple-algebra outer automorphisms and different regimes require reconciliation. This is not an SM-embedding, anomaly or viability check.

reconciliation.policy: A newly complete correction is NOT a new model just because the old incomplete registry has no exact signature. Reuse the known legacy entry after review.
